transport: assembled-demo deduplicated adapters; local no-store HTTP; selected original compiled cart/JSON API fixture

methods.browserReadiness: renderer performance.now from navigation time origin; complete visible fixture in two consecutive animation frames; identity/predicate rechecked after original assertions; recorder stopped before memory sampling; workflow validation gates publication
methods.cold: fresh browser process/profile/context per observation; OS/server caches may be warm; browser launch separate
methods.timing: automation wall time; rotated workload/mode order; descriptive median/min/max; no percentile or budget claim
methods.memory: browser-family Linux smaps_rollup PSS, stable process identities/membership; main JS and native capacity separate, never added to PSS
methods.sampling: snapshots after network/render idle outside timed intervals; no explicit GC; diagnostic work occurs between readiness and first use
methods.workers: live dedicated workers observed by Playwright, separate from creation/job counters and OS processes
